summary: S.J.Res. 84 is a joint resolution that uses the Congressional Review Act to officially disapprove of and nullify a federal rule issued by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. If enacted, the rule would have no force or effect.

summary_detail.plain_summary: S.J.Res. 84 is a joint resolution that uses the Congressional Review Act to officially disapprove of and nullify a federal rule issued by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. If enacted, the rule would have no force or effect.
summary_detail.significance: This joint resolution represents a legislative attempt to block a specific administrative rule governing health insurance marketplaces, health insurance enrollment requirements, and essential health benefits.
